title: The sprint, backlog and item skills, the kb-worker agent and the runbook describe the procedure the tools run
goal: Where .claude/skills/kb-sprint, kb-backlog and kb-item, .claude/agents/kb-worker.md and kb/_self/backlog.md describe a procedure the tools no longer run, the sentence is fixed, and where they are silent on one a worker needs, a sentence is added; no rule changes and no heading is renamed. The procedure: backlog.py land refuses a tree with untracked files, so a landing in the main checkout moves the intake drafts aside and back; claim --commit commits only the item it claims, so a sprint's own file and its review and research stories get a planning commit before the claim sync; a story's checks need a --goal and a check that runs real tool code (python3 -c pass is refused); set --touch replaces the whole list, so a gone path is removed by re-setting the list; selfdoc.py stale --since origin/main prints stale=0 at a landing, a mapped doc read and found correct goes in a Self-Reviewed: trailer, and a change under kb/_self/reports/ makes design.md stale; delegation runs as headless claude -p --model sonnet|haiku --output-format json sessions, which cannot write under .claude/ and edit staging copies the manager copies back; land --wait-merge 1800 lands a code item in one run, a content-only item goes straight to main, and kb/_self/_decisions.csv or backlog JSON beside code is the code lane; the review story's checks are backlog.py check and tests.py, with no stress suite and no test tiers; the review of a sprint that deleted or renamed tests or tool flags runs backlog.py selectors and re-points or drops the open items whose checks name them; a goal figure that a gate answer turns into a maximum is rewritten before the start.

run: import pathlib,re,sys;s=pathlib.Path('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');w=pathlib.Path('.claude/agents/kb-worker.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');need=[('untracked',s),('claude -p',s),('--wait-merge',s),('selectors',s),('stress',s),('Self-Reviewed',w)];bad=[k for k,t in need if (k not in t) != (k=='stress')];print('missing or stale:',bad);sys.exit(int(bool(bad)))

notes: From the SP-qzip6qar retrospective (accepted by the operator): the headless route's description also names the worker's worktree, made by the orchestrator after the claim sync under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id> on work/<id> so land removes it; starting the session with the project settings so its work reaches backlog.py cost (kb/_self/usage.md; BG-maqf3lxh for the claim window); and the orchestrator doing every edit under .claude/ itself.
